name: Meshillemoth
overview: Meshillemoth was a male member of the tribe of Ephraim known primarily as the father of Berechiah, who assisted the defeated Judaites. His role is briefly noted in the historical context of Judah's struggles, highlighting his family's involvement in aiding others during difficult times. There are no additional personal details recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Meshillemoth means 'restitution,' a proper name mentioned in 2 Chronicles 28:12. This meaning may reflect a theme of restoration or compensation, though the name itself is not indicated as given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Meshillemoth as the father of Berechiah, who played a role in helping the defeated Judaites. He is also explicitly identified as a descendant of the tribe of Ephraim. Beyond these relationships, no further family connections are documented.
scriptureSignificance: Meshillemoth's significance lies in his connection to Berechiah, who aided the people of Judah after their defeat, demonstrating a compassionate response during a time of national distress. This association places Meshillemoth within the broader narrative of God's people responding to adversity. His mention in 2 Chronicles 28:12 situates him within the historical record of Israel's tribal and familial lines, underscoring the interconnectedness of God's covenant community.
